title: Inference signal taxonomy and competitive decision canvas
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a compact, operational taxonomy of inference signals (latency, cost-per-token, quantization tolerance, hardware affinity, regional availability, compliance posture) and a decision canvas that product and sales can use to triage model-selection and fallback rules for enterprise customers. This ticket consolidates competitive signals, field interviews, telemetry snapshots, and procurement triggers into a single playbook and a short PRD with recommended Console UX hooks (alerts, model tags, route policies).
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy doc covering at least 8 signal families with definition and measurement guidance
Decision canvas (1-page) that maps customer personas to procurement triggers and fallback thresholds
Annotated list of top 12 competitor model variants and which signals differentiate them (region, quant, latency tiers)
Concrete Console feature recommendations: 3 alert types, 2 dashboard widgets, and 1 rollout policy pattern
Handoff to Analytics/Infra: a telemetry query and synthetic workload recipe to capture required metrics
